explanation: States the strengthened Baumgartner claim (from the end of [Ba75]): in any ℚ-vector space and for each k, some X meets every infinite AP but contains at most 2 points of any k-term AP. Small k are trivially fine. Its solved status rests on Baumgartner's remark that a slight modification of his method gives it. The docstring makes that provenance clear.
